entries.27916ec555156827: A service that uses genetic recombination technology to create cell lines that efficiently express recombinant proteins (antigens and antibodies), so that they can be supplied stably.
entries.3c91f5e5c3bc9164: A service that expresses recombinant proteins (antigens) required for antibody production and antibodies for research and development use in cells, and purifies them. It selects expression and purification methods according to the type and also performs analysis of purity and physical properties.
entries.473d85b5fef82cdc: A business that conducts research and development of antibody drug candidates in disease areas where treatments are insufficient, and receives upfront payments, milestones, royalties and other income by granting pharmaceutical companies and others licenses (out-licensing) to intellectual property such as lead antibodies resulting from the research. The main areas are from basic and exploratory research through preclinical development and early clinical development. There was no revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025.
entries.49211fc702774f52: Antibody Affinity Maturation Using the ADLib® System
entries.53bbed0dfb75c2d8: IDD Business (platform-type support for antibody drug discovery)
entries.64df7716526660e0: A service that produces monoclonal antibodies for drug discovery research using antibody production technologies such as the ADLib® system and the hybridoma method. It proposes antibody production plans tailored to customer needs.
entries.ae6d9fe9c645d81b: A platform-type business launched in 2025 that uses knowledge, experience and technologies accumulated from exploratory research through clinical development of antibody drugs to support solutions to challenges faced by pharmaceutical companies, drug discovery startups and others. It also provides support for biosimilar development, and its revenue is included in the net sales of the Drug Discovery Support Business.
entries.c893b50907fd9a75: Antibodies for research and development use
entries.d91ccbc15f11cea2: A business that uses the technology and know-how of the ADLib® system to improve the binding strength of antibodies (antibody affinity). It is expected to lead to antibody drugs with higher drug efficacy.
entries.e02ca7bd9541a914: Out-licensing candidate antibodies (PCDC, PTRY, PXLR, etc.)
entries.ea149baee630d0fb: Protein and Antigen Preparation, Antibody Expression and Purification
entries.f64bc077271d0acd: Out-licensing candidate products, including PCDC, which is mainly targeted for out-licensing activities for antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) applications, PTRY, a Tribody® cancer therapeutic candidate antibody, and PXLR, a cancer therapeutic candidate antibody. PFKR, which targets autoimmune neurological diseases, was licensed to Asahi Kasei Pharma Corporation in November 2024.
entries.f83ddcfdc36782e1: This business supports drug discovery research carried out by pharmaceutical companies, diagnostics companies and research institutions such as universities. It provides services including the preparation of proteins and antigens, expression and purification of antibodies, antibody production, and improvement of antibody affinity. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥593 million, which accounts for all of the company's revenue. Revenue from the IDD Business, launched in the current fiscal year, is also included in this business's revenue.
entries.fb7cabb6e4ffb6ce: A company engaged in a drug discovery business that generates antibody drug candidates using its proprietary antibody generation technology and out-licenses them to pharmaceutical companies, and a drug discovery support business that provides research support services such as antibody generation and protein preparation.
entries.fd3bfdd760e69d2a: Antibody Production Using the ADLib® System, etc.
